full_judgment: 2. Facts giving rise to this appeal are that the predecessor of the appellant as the pre-emptor filed Miscellaneous Case No.8 of 1985 in the Court of Assistant Judge, Balaganj, Sylhet for preemption of the case land under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 (the Act, 1950) stating, inter alia, that he was a co-sharer by purchase in the case holding. Opposite party Nos.2 and 3 (in the miscellaneous case) transferred the case land to the pre-emptee by three registered kabalas dated 17.10.1978, 22.03.1979 and 26.01.1980 without serving any notice upon the preemptor. The pre-emptee was a stranger in the case holding. The preemptor came to know about the said transfers in the month of Poush, 1391 B.S. when the pre-emptee disclosed to the pre-emptor that he had purchased the case land from opposite party Nos. 2 and 3. The pre-emptor then obtained the certified copies of the said kabalas on 15.01.1985 and 16.01.1985 respectively and got definite knowledge about the aforesaid transfers in question and then filed the preemption application on 22.01.1985.
